verdict.rationale: Quo ships some built-in autonomous background behavior. Its Sona AI agent answers calls when the team can't, captures details, and hands off conversations. Recorded calls are automatically transcribed and summarized, and calls can be routed by rules such as ring orders and phone menus. There is no evidence of a user-configurable automation or workflow builder with triggers, conditions, actions or schedules. The webhook and API are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented automation or workflow builder, user-defined triggers and actions, recurring or scheduled background tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Sona's autonomous operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Sona answers when your team can't, captures the details you need, and hands the conversation to your team when it matters.
Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
Custom ring orders ... Call transfers ... Phone menus
